items.title: Register for and withhold Detroit city income tax
items.authority: City of Detroit Income Tax Division / Michigan Department of Treasury
items.description: Employers with a location in Detroit or doing business there register with the city, withhold city income tax monthly or quarterly, and file the annual reconciliation.

items.title: File Detroit corporate or partnership income tax return
items.authority: Michigan Department of Treasury (for the City of Detroit)
items.description: Corporations and partnerships doing business in Detroit file the city return, which the Michigan Department of Treasury has processed since 2017.
